containment: reject every symlink, junction and reparse point before reading/copying; stricter than contained-link allowance
manifest: closed authoring allowlist; unknown fields fail export (NOT the generic draft host-loader ignore rule)
extensions: namespace validated, but no extensions emitted in skills-only export
discovery: immediate child SKILL.md only; report invalid skills separately; release requires all 13 valid
lock: exact inventory equality including added/deleted files, version identity and scope
output: fresh destination only; never silently replace an existing export
